exact: termination of G-protein coupled receptor signaling pathway
termination of G-protein coupled receptor signalling pathway

definition: The signaling process in which G protein-coupled receptor signaling is brought to an end. For example, through the action of GTPase-activating proteins (GAPs) that act to accelerate hydrolysis of GTP to GDP on G-alpha proteins, thereby terminating the transduced signal.
label: termination of G protein-coupled receptor signaling pathway
